falseSynonyms.zh: 外交官不一定等於大使 diplomat 是較大的職業類別；ambassador 是特定高級外交代表。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every ambassador is a diplomat, but not every diplomat is an ambassador.

falseSynonyms.zh: 領事不等於大使 consul 通常負責公民、簽證及商務等領事事務；ambassador 代表國家處理更高層外交關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A consul and an ambassador have different official roles.

falseSynonyms.zh: 代表團成員不一定等於 ambassador delegate 通常獲派參加會議或代表團，任務可以很短暫；ambassador 的代表角色通常更持續或更具象徵性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A conference delegate represents a group at a meeting; an ambassador may hold a broader representative role.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳話者不等於代表 messenger 主要負責傳遞訊息，不一定有權代表組織立場。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A messenger carries a message; an ambassador represents a country, organisation, or cause.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主人／主持人不等於 ambassadors host 負責接待或主持活動；只有在某些迎賓 ambassador 角色中兩者才可能重疊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A host runs or receives guests at an event; an ambassador represents a wider organisation or place.

falseSynonyms.zh: 倡議者不一定等於 ambassador advocate 主動支持某個立場或議題；ambassador 的核心是代表身份，未必進行政策倡議。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An advocate promotes a cause; an ambassador represents a group or cause publicly.
